description: BL2/T318. The exact command shape a delegated executor ran on 2026-08-25 to 'tidy' files outside its writable scope, discarding every uncommitted append to the audit log, the observation queue and the session ledger with no deny and no record. `git checkout -- <paths>` names three .keel/ targets after a `--` pathspec marker, so this is the write shape regardless of the branch/path ambiguity ordinary `checkout` carries, and it is refused before it can touch disk. A fresh plan is on file, reproducing the real incident's shape exactly - the pre-fix gate ALLOWED this outright (plan gate satisfied, nothing else asked); only this rule's own presence turns it into a refusal.
